message.content:
The vertical rectangular image is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters at the top. Below the title, the text "22-28 FEBRUARI 2016" appears. The upper margin contains the text "UNTUNG RUGI DIVESTASI FREEPORT" and "FASILITAS WAH UNTUK HAKIM."

The central illustration depicts a light-skinned man with short dark hair and orange glasses. He wears a short-sleeved orange jumpsuit. He is shown from the torso up, leaning forward over a green circular table. His mouth is open, his right hand is balled into a fist, and his left hand is splayed flat on the table surface. Across his torso, the white text "AHOK VS PENGUASA KALIJODO" is written at an upward angle.

Encircling the table are several pairs of disembodied hands in shades of red, yellow, and orange. These hands hold playing cards, poker chips, and a white drink carton with a straw. On the table are stacks of red, white, and black poker chips, scattered coins, and a clear plastic cup with a straw. One hand in the lower left wears a camouflage-patterned sleeve. A barcode and "RP 39.500" are printed in the bottom right corner.
